column1: # Latin-script words of the electronics volume, in addition to tools/content/terms_allowlist.tsv (read by tools/content/terms_check.py).
# Columns (TAB-separated): word, kind (abbr | mark | name | symbol), explanation, reason. Explanation is «—» unless kind is abbr.
# A word may be listed only once across both files: LED, MOSFET, THD, IEC, AA are global; units (V, mA, kΩ, μF, eV, nm, lm),
# single letters, E12/E24 and part numbers that start with a digit (1N4148, 2N3904) are exempt.
# Rows: every Latin word PATH.md puts into a step (on-screen fields and «Д»), plus NPN and PNP for «Докладніше» (batch E3 plan).
